ernst-cassirer.oneLineEn: Philosophy of symbolic forms linking neo-Kantianism, cultural philosophy, and philosophy of science.

ernst-troeltsch.oneLineEn: Historicism and philosophy of religion; interface among Dilthey, Weber, and theological modernity.

etienne-gilson.oneLineEn: Historian of medieval philosophy and Thomist revival; after Aquinas and Maritain.

fakhr-al-din-al-razi.oneLineEn: Summative theologian-philosopher who reshaped later kalām after absorbing and critiquing Ibn Sīnā.

fan-zhen.oneLineEn: Southern Dynasties thinker who, in On the Extinction of the Soul, attacked immortal-soul and karmic doctrines.
keywordsEn: On the Extinction of the Soul

fazlur-rahman.oneLineEn: Neo-modernist Islamic thinker whose double-movement hermeneutics remade modern Qurʾānic ethical reform.

fh-bradley.oneLineEn: British absolute idealist; a main target of the Russell-Moore revolt.

francisco-romero.oneLineEn: Argentine philosopher who professionalized academic philosophy and developed personhood and spiritual life theory.

frank-ramsey.oneLineEn: Early hub of truth, probability, decision, and economic philosophy in the Cambridge analytic tradition.

franz-brentano.oneLineEn: Hub of the intentionality revival linking Aristotle, scholastic psychology, Husserl, and analytic mind.

fukuzawa-yukichi.oneLineEn: Meiji Enlightenment leader who drove modern Japanese thought via civilization theory and independence.

gabino-barreda.oneLineEn: Mexican Comtean positivist who used educational reform as a tool of social-order reconstruction.

gabriel-marcel.oneLineEn: Christian existentialist filling the non-Sartrean branch of existentialism.

gampopa.oneLineEn: Founder of Dakpo Kagyu, fusing Kadampa lamrim with Mahāmudrā.

gangesa.oneLineEn: Core Navya-Nyāya figure who, in Jewel of Truth, advanced precise logic and epistemology.

gao-panlong.oneLineEn: Late Ming Donglin leader stressing both quiet-sitting cultivation and political integrity.

gassendi.oneLineEn: Reviver of Epicurean atomism and contemporary critic of Descartes in the Meditations objections.

georg-simmel.oneLineEn: Formal sociology and cultural philosophy linking Lebensphilosophie, modernity, and social theory.

george-herbert-mead.oneLineEn: Social behaviorism and theory of the self; fills the pragmatist social-psychology line.

george-santayana.oneLineEn: Naturalism, skepticism, and aesthetics at the edge of American non-pragmatist philosophy.
